description: This file defines the 'ProposedOrder' class used within the Manufacturing Planning and Reordering (MRP) process in the OFBiz framework. It models proposed manufacturing or procurement orders, including methods for calculating start dates, quantities, and creating requirement records.

classes.name: ProposedOrder
classes.description: Models a proposed manufacturing or procurement order with capabilities to calculate start date, quantity, and to create requirement records in the system.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the proposed order.

methods.name: getRequirementStartDate
methods.description: Returns the calculated start date for the proposed order.

methods.name: calculateStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the start date for the order based on routing, product type, and other parameters, adjusting for lead times and start/end dates.

methods.name: calculateQuantityToSupply
methods.description: Determines the quantity to supply, adjusting based on reorder quantities and minimum stock levels.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a requirement record for this proposed order using the provided dispatch context and user login.

methods.name: setMrpName
methods.description: Sets the MRP name associated with the proposed order.
